paper.title: PRIME: Training Free Proactive Reasoning via Iterative Memory Evolution for User-Centric Agent
paper.central_claim: 通过多轮信用分配蒸馏、演化及检索三类记忆，冻结agent持续改善用户协作，八环境与RL竞争、少5–6倍GPU小时并跨模型架构转移。

provenance.notes: 按已配置sonnet类型执行；环境标示gpt-6.1-sol，无独立运行凭据/会话ID可存，不额外探测。

evidence.support_explanation: 作者原主张包含部署持续适应、跨模型及可解释；不可默默缩窄。

evidence.support_explanation: R2G/Equalized选3关键轮后GPT-4o抽象结构化记忆。

evidence.quote: Trigger: experience retrieved but led to suboptimal outcome
evidence.support_explanation: 反馈触发mutation；其余算子generalize/crossover/prune，不等于候选经独立测试接受。

evidence.quote: Pruning removes experiences with low usage counts or poor success rates to maintain library quality.
evidence.support_explanation: 有维护，Table3阈值<2次或成功率<0.3、每2轮；没有独立反事实信用或事务回退协议。

evidence.quote: For distillation and evolution, we use GPT-4o as the summarization and reasoning backbone.
evidence.support_explanation: 辅助强模型用量属于成本/替代解释，不能把所有开销称作仅小冻结基模前向。

evidence.quote: All environments use Qwen3-32B as the user simulator to ensure consistent and reproducible evaluation across methods.
evidence.support_explanation: 用户均为模拟器；未见人类一致性审计或奖励校准。

evidence.quote: Qwen3-8B + PRIME achieves 193% improvement on FunctionGym and 50% on TauGym over the raw base model.
GRPO training produces larger absolute performance gains through direct parameter optimization
evidence.support_explanation: 不支持全面匹敌RL；8B GRPO Function0.423/Tau0.210大于PRIME0.278/0.072。

evidence.quote: PRIME requires 5–6 times fewer GPU-hours per environment compared to GRPO.
evidence.support_explanation: GPU小时效率报告，但外部GPT-4o、embedding及选择API未计全。

evidence.quote: we construct experience libraries using Qwen3-8B and apply them to Qwen3-4B at inference time.
evidence.support_explanation: 同模型族尺寸转移，图示4环境，仅定性说明；不等于跨任务/独立未见任务验证。
100是探索轨迹数，不是已说明的独立测试样本量。

evidence.quote: Combine related questions to be efficient.
evidence.support_explanation: base prompts已有与蒸馏经验相似策略，需prompt公平和random/raw-memory基线。

evidence.quote: These baselines represent established strategies for improving agent behavior without parameter updates and serve as the most direct comparison to PRIME’s experience-guided approach.
evidence.support_explanation: 宣称ReAct/Reflexion，但Table1未列这两者定量行，不能视为已完成比较。
